calibration.above_frozen_calibration_range: treat observation as missing; do not extrapolate calibration

timestamp_and_schedule.schedule_definition: Each node freezes one schedule_anchor_utc and sampling_interval_minutes before outcome-bearing deployment.
timestamp_and_schedule.duplicate_rule: More than one valid raw observation mapping to one scheduled timestamp is an error, not an averaging opportunity.
timestamp_and_schedule.sensor_rule: One simultaneously deployed outcome-bearing sensor/channel per node in this v1 builder; sensor reuse across predeclared simultaneous nodes is prohibited.

common_window.rule: Before raw PAR QC exclusion, common_start is the later of July 24 local midnight and the latest deployment among every predeclared optical-primary node; common_end is the earlier of September 4 local midnight and the earliest retrieval among those nodes.
common_window.no_rescue: Do not remove a sensor-failure node to widen/shift the common exposure window. The failing node may later be complete-case excluded, but the window remains the one frozen from the full predeclared manifest.

astronomical_daylight.daylight_boundary_ppfd: PPFD fixed to 0 at astronomical sunrise and sunset for DLI trapezoidal integration

daily_dli.interpolation: Linear interpolation only at missing scheduled daylight timestamps bracketed by known points whose separation is <=30 minutes.
daily_dli.long_gap_rule: Any daylight known-point gap >30 minutes invalidates the whole node-day.
daily_dli.integration: Trapezoidal integration of calibrated/interpolated PPFD over astronomical daylight; divide micromoles by 1e6 to obtain mol photons m-2 d-1.
daily_dli.nighttime: zero by definition and excluded from daylight-coverage denominator

node_exposure.primary: arithmetic mean of valid daily within-canopy DLI values across the frozen common window
node_exposure.overall_par_coverage: valid mapped scheduled observations / all scheduled observations across the common window
node_exposure.failed_nodes: Retain in exposure/QC output with optical_exposure_qc_pass=false; do not alter the common window.

primary_input_join.rule: One-to-one node join of frozen optical exposure/QC with node-level pre/post TNC summary.
primary_input_join.primary_qc_pass: optical_exposure_qc_pass AND tnc_pair_qc_pass AND pre/post TNC interval within 39-45 days
primary_input_join.registry_mismatch: error; do not silently inner-join away nodes

claim_boundary: Exposure preprocessing is response-independent and does not read TNC or future meadow response.
The TNC join is deterministic and cannot modify PAR exposure, DLI validity or the common window.
Do not replace mean daily DLI with a threshold, percentile, above-canopy metric or favorable seasonal window after TNC inspection.
A supported primary coefficient remains a prospective actual-light/reserve association, not proof that light alone or epiphytes caused reserve change.
